Help great ideas make it across the finish line.

You can write a caption that sounds like the brand, spot a missed detail before it becomes a problem, and keep a project moving without letting the next deadline sneak up on you. If that sounds like you, CADE Advertising would like to meet you.

We’re seeking a Junior Account Executive to support our Account Manager with client project coordination and manage the day-to-day social media presence of CADE and our clients. You’ll work with our creative team, turn plans into organized action, and help brands show up consistently and confidently online.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the creative work and the coordination that makes it happen. Your contributions will be visible—in the work we deliver and the relationships we build.

About Cade Advertising:

Cade Advertising has been a full-service, award-winning creative agency based in Tallahassee, Florida, for over 30 years. We help our clients advance their businesses through imaginative ideas, creative design, innovative solutions, and sound marketing strategy. Our culture is creative and casual, with high standards for the work and respect for the people doing it.

What You’ll Do:

· Help the Account Manager coordinate client projects, track deadlines, organize assets, and follow up with the team.

  • Prepare meeting notes, project updates, draft briefs, and client communication as assigned.
  • Manage content calendars for all agency and client social media accounts.
  • Write captions, develop content ideas, and coordinate graphics, photos, and short-form videos with our creative team.
  • Schedule and publish approved content that reflects each brand’s voice and goals.
  • Monitor comments, messages, and mentions; respond within approved guidelines and elevate issues when needed.
  • Review social media performance, prepare monthly reports, and recommend ways to improve results.
  • Proofread work, maintain organized files and approval records, and track time accurately by client and project.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong writing skills and an eye for details that others miss.
  • The ability to stay organized, manage competing deadlines, and follow through.
  • Practical social media experience beyond simply using the apps: creating content, managing a calendar, engaging an audience, or interpreting performance.
  • Professional communication, good judgment, and a willingness to ask questions and learn.
  • A team-oriented approach and the confidence to bring ideas and solutions to the table.
  • Comfort with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn project management and social media tools.

A degree in advertising, marketing, communications, public relations, or a related field is helpful, as is equivalent practical experience. This is a junior role; approximately 0–2 years of relevant experience is preferred. Internships, freelance work, student organizations, and strong project samples count. Experience with Canva, Adobe tools, Meta Business Suite, or short-form video is a plus.

Why CADE?

  • Work on a variety of brands and projects alongside an experienced creative team.
  • Build practical skills in account service, project coordination, and social media management.
  • Contribute ideas and see them become real client work.
  • Join a team that values kindness, accountability, creative thinking, and client success.

Position Details:

Full-time, 40 hours per week. In person in Tallahassee, Florida. This position reports to the Account Manager.

How to Apply:

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a brief note explaining why this role fits your strengths. Include two or three examples of social media content, captions, or campaigns you helped create or manage. Links or a PDF are welcome. Tell us what you contributed; student, internship, freelance, and personal project examples are all welcome. Please omit confidential client information.

Equal Opportunity:

Cade Advertising is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to a respectful, inclusive workplace.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

  • 401(k) matching
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, organized, and technically proficient Digital Marketing Manager to oversee the execution and day-to-day management of client digital marketing campaigns.

This position serves as the operational link between our sales team, clients, internal staff, and digital marketing partners. The Digital Marketing Project Manager is responsible for moving campaigns from the point of sale through onboarding, setup, launch, monitoring, reporting, and completion—ensuring projects are delivered accurately, on time, and according to client expectations.

The ideal candidate has a strong working knowledge of digital marketing, excellent project-management skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client campaigns simultaneously. This position also supervises sales support and campaign-trafficking personnel and will help develop processes that allow our digital marketing business to grow efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Campaign & Project Management

  • Manage digital marketing campaigns from onboarding through launch, fulfillment, reporting, and completion.
  • Coordinate campaign requirements, creative assets, targeting information, budgets, schedules, tracking, and client approvals.
  • Manage multiple client projects and campaigns simultaneously while maintaining deadlines and accuracy.
  • Ensure campaigns are properly submitted, launched, monitored, and documented.
  • Coordinate with internal staff, digital marketing partners, vendors, and platforms to ensure successful campaign execution.
  • Monitor campaign progress and identify potential delays, missing materials, or performance concerns.
  • Maintain project timelines and communicate campaign status to sales representatives, clients, and management.
  • Conduct quality-control reviews to ensure campaign specifications and client instructions are accurately implemented.

Digital Marketing Knowledge

Maintain a strong working knowledge of digital marketing tactics and platforms, including:

  • Paid search and search engine marketing (SEM/PPC)
  • Paid social media advertising
  • Display and programmatic advertising
  • Search engine optimization (SEO)
  • Local SEO and local search marketing
  • Website and landing-page campaigns
  • Email marketing
  • Retargeting and audience targeting
  • Video and connected-TV advertising
  • Digital analytics, conversion tracking, and campaign reporting
  • Emerging digital and AI-driven marketing technologies

The Digital Marketing Project Manager is not expected to personally execute every specialized digital marketing service but must understand the strategies, terminology, workflow, and performance metrics necessary to effectively manage campaigns and communicate with clients, sales representatives, and specialists.

Client Onboarding & Service

  • Coordinate onboarding of new digital marketing clients after the sale.
  • Gather campaign objectives, creative assets, account access, targeting information, and other materials necessary to launch campaigns.
  • Help translate client objectives and sales commitments into clear campaign requirements.
  • Communicate professionally with clients regarding campaign setup, timelines, deliverables, reporting, and required materials.
  • Respond to routine client questions and coordinate resolution of campaign-related issues.
  • Assist sales representatives with campaign reviews and client meetings when digital expertise or project updates are needed.
  • Help maintain strong client relationships through responsive communication, organization, and reliable campaign execution.

Sales Support

  • Provide operational and technical support to the sales team throughout the digital advertising process.
  • Review digital campaign requirements to ensure proposed programs can be properly executed.
  • Assist with gathering information needed for digital proposals and campaign recommendations.
  • Coordinate completed sales agreements with campaign fulfillment.
  • Maintain accurate client, campaign, and project information within the company's CRM and related systems.
  • Help ensure campaign fulfillment, reporting, and documentation support timely and accurate billing.
  • Support integrated advertising programs that may include both digital and print components when necessary.

Staff Supervision & Workflow Management

  • Supervise and provide day-to-day direction to Customer Service/Sales Support and campaign-trafficking personnel.
  • Assign work, establish priorities, and monitor workloads and deadlines.
  • Train employees on campaign workflow, systems, documentation, client service, and quality-control procedures.
  • Establish clear expectations for accuracy, responsiveness, organization, and accountability.
  • Provide coaching and feedback to improve staff performance and productivity.
  • Help management identify staffing, training, and resource requirements as the digital business grows.

Campaign Reporting & Quality Control

  • Coordinate recurring client campaign reports and ensure reports are delivered according to schedule.
  • Review reports for accuracy, completeness, and presentation before client delivery.
  • Understand and help communicate important digital performance metrics, including impressions, clicks, click-through rates, conversions, cost-per-click, cost-per-acquisition, website traffic, engagement, and other campaign-specific KPIs.
  • Identify significant campaign trends or performance concerns and coordinate appropriate follow-up with digital specialists and sales representatives.
  • Maintain organized records of campaign activity, reporting, changes, and client communications.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Help develop standardized processes for client onboarding, campaign trafficking, project management, reporting, and quality control.
  • Create and maintain checklists, templates, procedures, and documentation.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks, repetitive administrative tasks, and opportunities for automation.
  • Recommend technology and process improvements that increase productivity and reduce errors.
  • Help integrate CRM, project-management, reporting, file-management, and other systems into an efficient workflow.
  • Assist management in developing scalable operating procedures as the company's digital marketing business grows.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in digital marketing, advertising, media, marketing project management, agency operations, or a related field.
  • Previous project-management experience strongly preferred.
  • Previous supervisory or team-lead experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of multiple digital marketing channels and advertising technologies.
  • Strong understanding of digital campaign terminology, metrics, and reporting.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients, sales professionals, digital specialists, vendors, and senior management.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and platforms quickly.
  • Demonstrated reliability, accountability, professionalism, and strong work ethic.

A bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, advertising, or a related field is preferred but may be substituted by relevant professional experience.

Technical Proficiency

Candidates should be proficient with common business technology and comfortable learning new platforms. Experience with the following is desirable:

  • CRM and sales-management systems
  • Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and OneDrive
  • Project-management and workflow platforms
  • Google Ads and Google Analytics
  • Meta and other social advertising platforms
  • Digital advertising and reporting dashboards
  • Website content-management systems
  • SEO and local-search tools
  • Email marketing platforms
  • Cloud-based collaboration and file-management systems

Direct experience with every platform is not required; however, candidates should demonstrate strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar systems.

Key Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on factors including:

  • Accuracy and timeliness of campaign launches
  • Successful management of project deadlines
  • Campaign fulfillment and completion
  • Quality and timeliness of client reporting
  • Client responsiveness and service
  • Reduction of campaign and trafficking errors
  • Organization and documentation
  • Effectiveness of staff supervision
  • Efficiency of internal workflow
  • Ability to manage increasing digital campaign volume
  • Contribution to client retention and overall digital revenue growth

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, and responsibilities.

This is a full-time position with a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Benefits and other employment terms will be discussed during the hiring process.
